biography.value: A Worldfire Colossus is a living catastrophe that has agreed, for now, to catastrophe on the summoner's behalf. World-Burning Presence on arrival sets the terms of the engagement — after it goes off, the battlefield is a fire hazard for everyone not designated as protected. The Primordial Aura at 20 feet means enemies cannot close without taking 14 fire damage per round before any attack lands. A summoner who calls one has made a decision about how this fight ends, and the Colossus will execute that decision with a thoroughness that renders tactical nuance largely irrelevant.

system.attacksNotes:
Cataclysm Strike [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 15 damage (8 + 7 Str) + 5 fire damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 fire damage; Burning + Prone; no save; all creatures within 10 feet take 10 fire damage.
  • Margin 3: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 fire damage + Burning + Prone + Stunned until end of their next turn; area damage increases to 16 fire.

World-Flame Hurl [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 150 ft, 20-foot diameter.

  • Margin 1:: 20 fire damage (17 + 3 Dex) + Ignited.
  • Margin 2: 20 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning.
  • Margin 3: 20 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning + Blinded until end of their next turn from the searing flash; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Primordial Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 20 feet take 11 fire damage (Half DR). Flammable terrain within 20 feet ignites and continues burning — the area becomes Difficult Terrain as fire spreads at normal rates. Powerful Build: The Worldfire Colossus counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. World-Burning Presence (1/day) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, the Worldfire Colossus expresses its full elemental nature in a 60-foot diameter. All non-designated creatures make a Reflex [Hard] save .

  • Margin 1:: 12 fire damage only. The ground within the area ignites if flammable; non-flammable surfaces become superheated (4 fire damage per round to creatures standing on them for the next minute).
  • Margin 2: 12 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Ignited.
  • Margin 3: 12 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning + Blinded for 1 minute.

Fire Immunity Sharing: The summoner and up to 4 designated allies gain immunity to non-magical fire damage within 60 feet. Intimidating Presence: As a [Combat] action all creatures within 30 feet that can see and hear it make a Will save (opposed by Cha 4 + Intimidate 5). On failure: target gains the Frightened condition for 1 minute. Creatures immune to fear are unaffected. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Worldfire Colossus fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
